name: ARD (Das Erste) — Technische Produktionsrichtlinien / HDF01a File Delivery (HD)

governance.source: Technische Produktionsrichtlinien zur Herstellung von Medienproduktionen für ARD, ZDF und ORF (1. Auflage, Nov 2025); MXF profile ARD_ZDF_HDF01a (IRT)
governance.notes: ARD (Das Erste + Landesrundfunkanstalten). Governed by the jointly published ARD/ZDF/ORF Technische Produktionsrichtlinien (CC BY-ND); standard HD exchange profile ARD_ZDF_HDF01a. Video: MXF OP1a XDCAM HD422 (MPEG-2 4:2:2 Long GOP, SMPTE RDD 9) 50 Mbit/s, 1920x1080i/25 TFF, 8-bit, BT.709, limited range (EBU R103 v3.0). Audio: PCM 24-bit/48 kHz, 8 discrete mono AES3 tracks (HDF01a; HDF01b=16 by agreement); EBU R128 -23 LUFS +/-0.5 LU (+/-1.0 live), LRA max 20 LU, true peak -1 dBTP. Track assignment per Medienbegleitkarte (Var.4 8-ch: A1/2 stereo mix, A3/4 IT/M&E, A5/6 2. Sprachfassung incl. Audiodeskription/Hoerfilm, A7/8 Sendeton/Dolby E). File delivery carries NO technical leader/bars/tone. TC start 10:00:00:00 (ORF uses 00:00:00:00; ZDF/ORF maintain their own overriding file specs). Subtitles: EBU STL sidecar (EBU-TT-D-Basic-DE online). Metadata: Medienbegleitkarte (BMF/MFT 2.0 XML). PSE not specified. Language de. NOTE: shared ARD_ZDF_HDF basis but ZDF (zdf_hd) and ORF (orf_hd) each have their own file specs — see those profiles.

codec.notes: XDCAM HD422 = MPEG-2 4:2:2 Long GOP, 50 Mbit/s, 8-bit (ISO/IEC 13818-2 / SMPTE RDD 9:2013). Profile ARD_ZDF_HDF01a. AVC-Intra 100 / XAVC (10-bit) are defined alternatives in the guidelines but HDF01a is the standard HD exchange profile.

container.notes: MXF OP1a; XDCAM HD422 per SMPTE RDD 9:2013 (Multiple Body Partition, Variante 1).

frame_rate.notes: 1080i/25 (50 fields/s). 1080p/25 must be carried and signalled as 1080psf/25 / 1080i/25.

color.notes: ITU-R BT.709-6 for all HD SDR signals.

codec.notes: Uncompressed PCM (discrete mono AES3). Dolby E only in defined multichannel exchange cases.

track_count.notes: HDF01a = 8 discrete mono tracks; HDF01b = 16 (by bilateral agreement). Assignment by essence track order, documented in the Medienbegleitkarte. Var.4 (8-ch): A1/2 stereo mix, A3/4 IT (M&E), A5/6 2. Sprachfassung (incl. Audiodeskription/Hoerfilm), A7/8 Sendeton (Dolby E or PCM silence). Var.5: discrete 5.1 (L R C LFE Ls Rs on A3-A8).

layout.notes: Stereo standard; multichannel (5.1 or 3.0) optional, exchanged preferably as discrete PCM (alternatively Dolby E). Stereo must be mono-compatible.

loudness.notes: EBU R128 (v5.0) + ITU-R BS.1770-5. Programme Loudness -23.0 LUFS +/-0.5 LU; +/-1.0 LU for live/as-live or where exact compliance is impractical. Loudness Range (LRA) max 20 LU in production. Max true peak -1 dBTP.

subtitles.notes: Subtitles delivered as a separate EBU STL file (ARD UT-Standards). Online distribution uses EBU-TT-D-Basic-DE (XML). Required for new productions. Audio description ('Hoerfilm') carried as a 2. Sprachfassung audio track, not a text service.

metadata.notes: Medienbegleitkarte based on a BMF XML sub-schema, transferred via MFT 2.0. Carries per-track audio assignment. No explicit filename convention in the TPR (deferred to broadcaster file specs).

timeline.notes: Continuous, gap-free timecode in the Material Package (ATC per SMPTE ST 12-2:2014); ARD start 10:00:00:00 (ORF uses 00:00:00:00). Deliver clean with NO technical leader/pre-/post-roll, no bars/tone, no ad breaks.

luminance.tolerance_note: EBU R103 v3.0 (8-bit nominal black 16 / white 235). RGB and resulting luma between -5% and +105% (-35 mV .. 735 mV); gamut error when exceeded over >1% of picture area. TRS values (8-bit 0/255) forbidden.
